change_reason: Boeing prompt/model tuning is closed. v1.3 checks clean-document QA, a predeclared controlled repair case, and observable non-gold candidate features on three new development documents before any policy-performance comparison.

scope.model_or_prompt_tuning: none after this spec is frozen
scope.boeing_rule: Boeing remains development diagnostic material; no further Boeing model or prompt tuning is permitted in v1.3
scope.claim_boundary: three-document controlled text-only development feasibility check; not a representative or independent policy evaluation and not evidence of natural error frequency, human verification success, multimodal performance, or general policy superiority

source_data.visual_audit: the seven cited PDF pages were rendered at 2x and checked for row labels, year columns, signs, units, and subtotal relationships before freezing
source_data.all_seen_material_rule: all three documents and all seven questions are development material and may not be reused as independent final evaluation

questions.evaluation_route: quick ratio=(current assets-raw inventory-work in process and finished goods)/current liabilities for each year
gross margin=gross profit/net sales for FY2023 and FY2022
gross margin=gross profit/revenue for FY2023, FY2022, and FY2021; evaluate adjacent annual changes against roughly two percentage points
questions.primary_aggregate_rule: retain answer dimensions but exclude unconditional overall correctness from the primary denominator until the benchmark explanation/task alignment is adjudicated

questions.evaluation_route: quick ratio=(cash+short-term investments+accounts receivable+related-party receivables)/current liabilities
questions.accepted_conclusion: yes, under the benchmark's greater-than-one convention
questions.caveat: the filing supplies inputs, while the label reasonably healthy and threshold are benchmark interpretation rather than a fact directly stated by AMD

model_and_pipeline.second_model_rule: no second generative model was installed at freeze time; the installed embedding model is not treated as a QA comparison model
model_and_pipeline.runtime_identity: record Ollama version, immutable model digest, parameter size, and quantization in the run manifest
model_and_pipeline.document_isolation: general retrieval is run separately per document so questions cannot retrieve another document's blocks
model_and_pipeline.arithmetic_tool: none; adding one would create a separately named pipeline version

clean_qa_conditions.general_retrieval: fresh BM25 retrieval over all clean page blocks from the question's own document
clean_qa_conditions.oracle_evidence: fresh QA call forced to the one full, clean, visually audited source page listed for the question; this diagnoses answering given evidence and is not system retrieval performance

failure_localization.oracle_wrong_or_incomplete: answer generation or output-contract failure remains even with sufficient evidence
failure_localization.invalid_or_missing_output: pipeline/output failure; never count as correct

evaluation.missing_vs_wrong: no numeric claim is MISSING_REQUIRED_NUMBERS, not a wrong number; a stated value with wrong magnitude/sign/period/unit/semantic role is INCORRECT
evaluation.equivalent_explanations: accept any source-supported calculation route sufficient for the requested conclusion; do not require every benchmark reference number
evaluation.manual_review: every live answer is reviewed against the rendered filing page in addition to deterministic checks
evaluation.benchmark_conflict: record separately from model error and exclude unresolved items from unconditional primary accuracy
evaluation.primary_denominator: six source-verified questions excluding financebench_id_00685's unresolved task/reference-completeness mismatch
evaluation.failure_rule: missing, unparseable, failed, uncited, unsupported, or unreviewed output is not correct

controlled_repair_case.eligibility_rule: execute after the clean oracle call regardless of its outcome; report clean failure and all repair states rather than replacing the case

repairs.A: restore the primary parser span 835 to 4,835 in the FY2022 cash row
repairs.B: restore the primary parser span 126 to 4,126 in the FY2022 accounts-receivable row

controlled_repair_case.frozen_metric_effect: under the benchmark greater-than-one conclusion, neither individual repair crosses 1.0 but AB does on the direct numerator route
controlled_repair_case.alternate_path: the unchanged total-current-assets, inventories, and prepaid values give (15,019-3,771-1,265)/6,369=1.5674360182 in every state
controlled_repair_case.duplicate_or_bypass_rule: do not remove the alternate route; if the model bypasses injected spans, retain the no-effect result
controlled_repair_case.error_origin: intentional post-extraction controlled text corruption; not a naturally occurring parser error or frequency estimate
controlled_repair_case.selection_leakage: reference answer, repair spans, correct values, and observed downstream effects are evaluation-only and absent from policy input

non_gold_features.parser_disagreement: per-page numeric-token multiset count difference between pypdf 6.10.0 primary text and PyMuPDF 1.28.2 extraction from the same PDF; actual second-parser observation, not a confidence score
non_gold_features.layout_mapping: PyMuPDF word bounding boxes and line/block identifiers matched by normalized numeric token and occurrence order; unmatched/ambiguous values remain explicitly unmatched rather than inferred
non_gold_features.subtotal_component_consistency: absolute residual of predeclared accounting identities read from the development tables; relations are human-configured from visible row labels and marked as such, not an automatic table parser
non_gold_features.candidate_risk_proxy: 0.70*binary_parser_count_disagreement + 0.30*max_normalized_constraint_residual; a development anomaly score, not a calibrated probability
non_gold_features.repairability: ideal exact repair if a verified controlled error is inspected; a simulation assumption, not downstream repair probability

policy_probe.candidate_universe: all numeric spans in the damaged primary-parser text of the three development documents, including normal candidates
policy_probe.individual_impact: rank the shared anomaly_score times observed question reach times the ideal-exact-repair assumption independently
policy_probe.graph_aware: greedy marginal score using the same per-candidate inputs and discounting already-covered downstream questions
policy_probe.post_selection_evaluation: only after selections are serialized, join controlled repair labels to measure inclusion and distinguishability

live_call_budget.stop_rule: do not add calls or prompt variants after observing outputs

required_before_policy_scoring: freeze a held-out document list and deterministic selection rule
freeze controlled error generation without using policy outcomes
freeze common candidate, information, unit-cost, budget, and metric rules
report overall and error-in-candidate conditional results
retain candidate misses, non-repairs, and identical policy selections

preservation.raw_policy: append-only ignored research/work directory with inputs, prompts in traces, retrievals, outputs, judgments, configs, runtime identity, manifest, and checksums
preservation.summary_policy: tracked report and summary never substitute for raw outputs
preservation.backup_status_at_freeze: project persistent local path is the primary copy; an independent second physical backup has not yet been verified
